meta.name: launch
meta.description: When the user wants to plan a product launch, feature announcement, or release strategy. Also use when the user mentions 'launch,' 'Product Hunt,' 'feature release,' 'announcement,' 'go-to-market,' 'beta launch,' 'early access,' 'waitlist,' 'product update,' 'how do I launch this,' 'launch checklist,' 'GTM plan,' or 'we're about to ship.' Use this whenever someone is preparing to release something publicly. For ongoing marketing after launch, see marketing-ideas. For the offer being launched (bonuses, guarantees, scarcity, naming), see offers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划产品发布与上市策略
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正计划公开推出产品或功能
copy.tagline_en: Plan your product launch and go-to-market strategy.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're preparing to publicly launch a product or feature.

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 会以发布策略专家的身份,指导你按自有、租用、借用三类渠道规划产品发布,推荐五阶段发布流程,并在需要时给出 Product Hunt 上线打法、发布优先级与核对清单。
howto.when: 当你说到发布、Product Hunt 等词,或提出准备公开推出产品/功能/公告时触发。例如提到‘launch’、‘feature release’、‘GTM plan’等。

say.text: 帮我把新功能上线拆成五个阶段,每步写清楚行动项。
say.note: Claude将按五阶段流程给出行动步骤。

say.text: 我想上 Product Hunt,帮我列一份上线当天的执行清单。
怎么用自有、租用、借用渠道来扩大这次发布的影响?

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as a launch strategy expert, guiding you through owned, rented, and borrowed channels, a five-phase launch process, Product Hunt tactics, update prioritization, and checklists.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention launches, Product Hunt, feature releases, announcements, go-to-market, beta launches, early access, waitlists, 'how do I launch this,' GTM plans, or anything about preparing to ship publicly.

say_en.text: Break my new feature launch into five phases, each with clear action items.
say_en.note: Claude will outline the five-phase process.

say_en.text: Give me a Product Hunt launch-day checklist.
How do I use owned, rented, and borrowed channels for this release?
